title: The Steady Climb
briefing: Orchard Foods is in a steady climb. Panic Pete is trading it too, and he scares easily. Hold your nerve.
objective: Hold your nerve. Don't let one scary headline shake you out of a good trend.
debrief: Orchard Foods climbed for ten days. On day 10 an analyst called it "overvalued": the stock gapped down about 4% and drifted lower for two more days. Nothing about the business had changed, and from day 13 the climb resumed. Panic Pete bought after a run of green days, sold at the gap and bought back higher. Players who were invested by day 5 and held through the headline usually finished ahead of him.

news.headline: Analyst calls Orchard Foods "overvalued"
news.body: A well-known analyst says Orchard Foods shares have risen too far. The company's sales and profits are unchanged.
